description: This source file defines a generic class 'WorkflowRouteEntries<TWorkflowRouteDocument>' implementing 'IWorkflowRouteEntries'. It manages workflow route entries, including adding, removing, and retrieving route entries based on HTTP method and route values, using dependency injection and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: WorkflowRouteEntries<TWorkflowRouteDocument>
classes.description: A generic class managing workflow route entries, supporting addition, removal, and retrieval of route entries based on HTTP method and route values.

methods.name: GetWorkflowRouteEntriesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves workflow route entries matching the specified HTTP method and route values.

methods.name: AddEntriesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a collection of workflow route entries to the document and updates it.

methods.name: RemoveEntriesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes entries associated with a specific workflow ID and updates the document.

methods.name: GetWorkflowRoutesEntries
methods.description: Filters route entries in the document based on HTTP method and route values, matching controller, action, and area names.

methods.name: AddEntries
methods.description: Static method to add grouped workflow route entries to the document.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Static method to remove entries from the document based on workflow ID.

methods.name: LoadDocumentAsync
methods.description: Loads the workflow route document for updating, not cached.

methods.name: GetDocumentAsync
methods.description: Gets the workflow route document for sharing, not for updates.

methods.name: CreateDocumentAsync
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the workflow route document asynchronously.
